rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sees, accompanies, and preserves the Prophet as he rises through the minor resurrection, the intermediate primordial state, and the major resurrection in unity and steadfastness.
rows.anchor: في النشأة في القيامة الصغرى والفطرة في الوسطى بالوحدة حين الاستقامة في الكبرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's turning is his passage through the stages of the annihilated in God's acts, attributes, and essence, by way of self, heart, and spirit, among their company.
rows.anchor: انقلابك وانتقالك في أطوار الفانين في أفعاله تعالى وصفاته وذاته بالنفس والقلب والروح في زمرتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Before the first creation, this turning also reaches through the loins of his prophetic forefathers, who had been annihilated in God.
rows.anchor: وقبل النشأة الاولى في أصلاب آبائك الأنبياء الفانين في الله عنها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blessed one in the fire is the heart of Moses, which reaches the fire through manifestations of divine attributes, finding real perfections and the prophetic station of intimate speech.
rows.anchor: هو موسى القلب الواصل إلى النار بتجليات الصفات الإلهية ووجدان الكمالات الحقيقية ومقام المكالمة عن النبوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those around the fire are spiritual faculties and celestial angels, receiving illuminations of unveiling, secret knowledge and wisdom, sacred confirmations, and inward states of spiritual tasting.
rows.anchor: من القوى الروحانية والملائكة السماوية بأنوار المكاشفة وأسرار العلوم والحكم والتأييدات القدسية والأحوال السرية والذوقية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Glorifying God means transcending the divine essence by shedding psychic qualities, bodily veils, defects, and faults.
rows.anchor: ونزه ذات الله بتجردك عن الصفات النفسانية والغواشي الجسدانية والنقائص والمعائب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is mighty because He subdues the self and all things through annihilation in Him, and wise because He teaches wisdom and guides Moses to intimate speech.
rows.anchor: القوي الذي قهر نفسك وكل شيء بالفناء فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses's staff is his sanctified self, joined to the light of holiness; after spiritual discipline he should release it and not prevent its movement, since it has become illumined.
rows.anchor: عصا نفسك القدسية المؤتلفة بشعاع القدس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The staff's shaking is the self's movement and renewed life, appearing as an overpowering serpent.
rows.anchor: { فلما رآها } تضطرب وتتحرك { كأنها } حية غالبة بالظهور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses turns toward God, fearing the self's appearance, and does not return but remains occupied with tending what remains.
rows.anchor: لم يرجع وبقي مشتغلا بتدارك البقية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A self revived after death through will and discipline becomes a veil and trial if it acts independently; Moses need not fear its domination in that case.
rows.anchor: فإن النفس إذا حييت بعد موتها بالإرادة وفنائها بالرياضة إن استقلت بنفسها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the self moves by God's command, enlivened by the spirit and divine love rather than its own desire, it is no veil.
rows.anchor: وإذا تحركت بأمري حية بنور الروح والمحبة الحقانية لا بهواها لم تكن حجابا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's messengers are those granted subsistence after annihilation and enlivened by His life.
rows.anchor: الذين أرسلتهم بالبقاء بعد الفناء وأحييت نفوسهم بحياتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The queen's gift represents sensory perceptions, psychic appetites, imagined and illusory pleasures, and material supports embellished by thoughts, impulses, and motives.
rows.anchor: من أموال المدركات الحسية والشهوات النفسية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The test is whether Solomon accepts the offer and inclines toward the self, or rejects it and becomes firmer in his inclination toward the Real.
rows.anchor: هل يقبلها فيلين ويميل إلى النفس أو يردها فيتصلب في الميل إلى الحق

words: فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What God has given Solomon is certain knowledge, sacred realities, intellectual pleasures, and luminous visions, better than sensory, imaginary, and illusory adornments.
rows.anchor: من المعارف اليقينية والحقائق القدسية واللذات العقلية والمشاهدات النورية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The queen's party rejoices in its gift; Solomon's party rejoices in what comes from God, not in the things the gift represents.
rows.anchor: وإنما فرحنا بما هو من عند الله لا بما ذكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses's mother symbolizes the simple, sound self that remains upon its primordial nature, the reproachful self; nursing him means feeding him with partial perceptions and beneficial first principles.
rows.anchor: { وأوحينا إلى أم موسى } أي: النفس الساذجة السليمة الباقية على فطرتها وهي اللوامة { أن أرضعيه } بلبان الإدراكات الجزئية والعلوم النافعة الأولية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the commanding self and its helpers threaten him, she casts him into the sea of material intellect and original potential, or conceals him in the sea of bodily nature, without fearing his death.
rows.anchor: { فألقيه } في يم العقل الهيولاني والاستعداد الأصلي أو في يم الطبيعة البدنية بالإخفاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: She should not grieve his separation: God will return him after discernment and right guidance appear, and make him one of the messengers to the Children of Israel.
rows.anchor: { إنا رادوه إليك } بعد ظهور التمييز ونور الرشد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh's family represents the dominant psychic faculties; discernment and protection require the aid of imagination, estimation, and the outer and inner senses.
rows.anchor: من القوى النفسانية الظاهرة عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ultimately a person learns that his fiercest enemy is the self between his sides, then subdues its helpers by discipline and annihilates it through restraint, breaking, and mortification.
rows.anchor: في العاقبة ويعلم أن أعدى عدوه النفس التي بين جنبيه فيقهرها وأعوانها بالرياضة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The man from the city's far edge is love that impels the journey to God, called will; he arises from the hidden store of preparedness when the self's desire is killed.
rows.anchor: هو الحب الباعث على السلوك في الله الذي يسمونه الإرادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Love moves with unmatched speed, warning Moses of the faculties' domination and their plotting when imaginative power rises against him through disputation and misguidance.
rows.anchor: إذ لا حركة أسرع من حركته يحذره عن استيلائهم عليه وينبهه على تشاورهم وتظاهرهم عند ظهور سلطان الوهم عليه ومقابلته ومماراته ومجادلته له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses must leave the psychic city's bounds and rule for the station of spirit.
rows.anchor: عن مدينتهم حدود سلطنتهم إلى مقام الروح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His departure means undertaking struggle in God and maintaining presence and watchfulness; he fears their dominance and seeks refuge in God from their oppression.
rows.anchor: { فخرج } بالأخذ في المجاهدة في الله ودوام الحضور والمراقبة { خائفا } من غلبتهم، متلجئا إلى الله في طلب النجاة من ظلمهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When he turns toward Midian, the station of spirit, strong will lets hope overcome fear as he seeks true guidance through spiritual lights and manifestations of the attributes on the path of unity and wayfaring in God.
rows.anchor: غلب رجاؤه على الخوف لقوة الإرادة وطلب الهداية الحقانية بالأنوار الروحية

words: إِنَّ قَٰرُونَ كَانَ مِن قَوْمِ مُوسَىٰ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qarun is identified as a learned man like Bal'am ibn Ba'ura.
rows.anchor: { إن قارون كان من قوم موسى } عالما كبلعم بن باعوراء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Veiled by ego and knowledge, Qarun grows arrogant and overbearing; greed and love of worldly life delude him, make him admire his own adornment, and draw him downward until he is swallowed while veiled and detested.
rows.anchor: لاحتجابه بنفسه وعلمه بالتكبر والاستطالة عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The next world is the enduring sacred realm for those not veiled by self and its qualities, whose innate aspiration rises toward spirit rather than turning into worldly pride, domination, or unjust accumulation.
rows.anchor: لا يحتجبون بنفوسهم وصفاتها فتصير فيهم الإرادة الفطرية الطالبة للترقي والعلو في سماء الروح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The good end belongs to those purified of ruinous vices and misleading desires.
rows.anchor: للمجردين الذين تزكت نفوسهم عن الرذائل المردية والأهواء المغوية

words: ٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Recitation unfolds the summarized Qur'anic intellect through revelation and the revealed book of discriminating knowledge; prayer arranges its details, joining perfection in knowledge with universal action.
rows.anchor: فصل ما أجمل فيك من كتاب العقل القرآني بسبب الوحي ونزول كتاب العلم الفرقاني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Beneficial knowledge concerns manners, deeds, and livelihood and comes from the faculties of the earthly unseen; noble knowledge concerns virtues and the afterlife and comes from the soul, breast, and theoretical intellect.
rows.anchor: إما نافعة تتعلق بالآداب والأعمال وإصلاح المعاش وهي علوم القوى من غيب الملكوت الأرضية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Universal certain knowledge of attributes is rational-theoretical or secret-unveiling knowledge, from the heart and secret; real knowledge of manifestations and witnessing comes from spirit.
rows.anchor: وإما كلية يقينية تتعلق بالصفات وهي على نوعين: عقلية نظرية وكشفية سرية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tasting, directly bestowed knowledge concerns love and union and comes from the hidden faculty; essential knowledge comes from the unseen of the unseen.
rows.anchor: وإما ذوقية لدنية تتعلق بالعشقيات والمواصلات وهي من غيب الخفاء. وإما حقية من غيب الغيوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first two corresponding prayers are bodily prayer through its forms and pillars, and the self's prayer through submission, reverence, compliance, and settled balance between fear and hope.
rows.anchor: فالأولى هي الصلاة البدنية بإقامة الأوضاع وأداء الأركان، والثانية صلاة النفس بالخضوع والخشوع والانقياد والطمأنينة بين الخوف والرجاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Heart prayer is presence and watchfulness; secret prayer is intimate conversation; spirit prayer is witnessing and seeing; hidden prayer is whispering and subtle affection.
rows.anchor: الثالثة صلاة القلب بالحضور والمراقبة، والرابعة صلاة السر بالمناجاة والمكالمة، والخامسة صلاة الروح بالمشاهدة والمعاينة، والسادسة صلاة الخفاء بالمناغاة والملاطفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There is no prayer at the seventh rank because it is annihilation and pure love in unity; in subsistence after annihilation all six prayers return along with a seventh, the Real's prayer through love and singularity.
rows.anchor: ولا صلاة في المقام السابع لأنه مقام الفناء والمحبة الصرفة الفناء في عين الوحدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Outward prayer ends at death, called manifest certainty; real prayer ends at absolute annihilation, the certainty of the Real, then the sevenfold prayer is renewed in subsistence.
rows.anchor: فكذلك انتهاء الصلاة الحقيقية بالفناء المطلق الذي هو حق اليقين

words: إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each prayer restrains its corresponding fault: bodily prayer from legal sins, self-prayer from vices, heart prayer from excess and heedlessness, secret prayer from attending to others and absence, spirit prayer from transgression, hidden prayer from duality and ego, and essence prayer from residual coloring and deviation in unity.
rows.anchor: فالصلاة البدنية تنهى عن المعاصي والسيئات الشرعية

rows.speaker: عليه السلام
rows.claim: The Prophet says that a worshipper who knew whom he was conversing with would not turn away, illustrating the inward attentiveness of prayer.
rows.anchor: كما قال عليه السلام: " لو علم المصلي من يناجي ما التفت "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The greatest remembrance is remembrance of the essence in pure annihilation; when firmly established in subsistence, the Real's prayer surpasses all remembrance and prayers.
rows.anchor: الذي هو ذكر الذات في مقام الفناء المحض، وصلاة الحق عند التمكين في مقام البقاء أكبر من جميع الأذكار والصلوات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows what people do through every spiritual station, condition, and prayer.
rows.anchor: في جميع المقامات والأحوال والصلوات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Debate People of the Book only graciously because they are veiled from religion rather than truth and retain receptivity; wisdom joins them in the shared goal of unity and in whatever part of their path accords with truth.
rows.anchor: لأنهم ليسوا محجوبين عن الحق بل عن الدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Affirm that the one God is the shared destination and join them in the straight parts of the way, including submission to the one true worshipped God, so they recognize their direction and find reassurance.
rows.anchor: كما قال: { وإلهنا وإلهكم واحد } ومرافقتهم في الطريق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gently affirm what is true in their worship and clarify what is false, allowing shared kindness to build trust and acceptance of guidance; those whose deeds have destroyed their readiness are hardened and respond only to force.
rows.anchor: ملاطفتهم في بيان كيفية سلوك الطريق بتصويب ما هو حق مما هو عليه وتبصير ما هو باطل لاحتجابهم عنه بالعبادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The unjust have ruined their own readiness and deprived it of its perfection through repeated excess; because they are people of coercion, gentle treatment cannot affect them.
rows.anchor: فإنهم أهل القهر لا يؤثر فيهم إلا القهر ولا تنجع فيهم الملاطفة للمضادة بين الوصفين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God begins creation by making the Persians prevail over the Romans and restores it by making the Romans prevail over the Persians; return to Him is annihilation in Him.
rows.anchor: { الله يبدأ الخلق } بإظهار الفرس على الروم { ثم يعيده } بإظهار الروم على الفرس { ثم إليه ترجعون } بالفناء فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Hour is either the minor resurrection, or the major resurrection with the Mahdi's appearance and subjugation of the veiled; then they are denied mercy and people are divided into believers and unbelievers.
rows.anchor: { ويوم تقوم الساعة } بوقوع القيامة الصغرى { يبلس المجرمون } عن رحمة الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is transcendent: nothing else shares in existence, attribute, act, or influence.
rows.anchor: أن يكون غيره في الوجود والصفة والفعل والتأثير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Evening and morning signify, respectively, Persian darkness prevailing over Roman light and then Roman light prevailing over Persian darkness.
rows.anchor: { حين تمسون } بغلبة ظلمة الفرس على نور الروم { وحين تصبحون } عند ظهور نورهم على ظلمة الفرس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Praise accompanies the perfection and beauty of God manifesting in the seven unseen heavens as spiritual light dawns over psychic darkness and the spirit's sun nears its rising; at evening, divine majesty appears in the body's earth as psychic darkness prevails.
rows.anchor: بظهور صفات كماله وتجليات جماله في سموات الغيوب السبعة وقت إصباح غلبة نور الروحانيات على ظلمات النفسانيات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Evening is the annihilation of the wayfarers and the spirit's sun setting in the essence; daytime appearance is subsistence after annihilation with steadiness and balance.
rows.anchor: { وعشيا } وقت فنائهم وغيبة شمس الروح في الذات { وحين تظهرون } في البقاء بعد الفناء عند الاستقامة والاستواء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Angel of Death is the universal human soul, which receives partial souls that retain primordial nature and have not reached total corruption; souls that do reach that limit are separated by the angels of punishment.
rows.anchor: النفس الإنسانية الكلية التي هي معاد النفوس الجزئية ما لم تسقط عن الفطرة بالكلية وإن احتجبت الهيئات الظلمانية والصفات النفسانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those still retaining a remnant of primordial light can see, hear, and wish to return despite being veiled and drawn downward by entrenched bodily dispositions; they do not remain eternally in Hell, but are corrected according to how deeply those dispositions are rooted and then return.
rows.anchor: وهؤلاء هم الذين لا يتخلدون في النار بل يعدلون بحسب رسوخ الهيئات ثم يرجعون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lesser punishment is the pain of consequences and fires caused by resisting the self and temperament through afflictions, hardships, and terrors; the greater punishment is veiling by darkness from the divine attributes and essence.
rows.anchor: الذي هو الاحتجاب بالظلمات عن أنوار الصفات والذات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lesser punishment may return them to God by cleansing their primordial nature through hardship before dense veiling and corruption take hold.
rows.anchor: إلى الله عند تصفية فطرتهم بشدة العذاب الأدنى قبل الرين بكثافة الحجاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses's book is the discriminating book of the intellect; the Prophet should not doubt meeting Moses when he reaches Moses's rank on his own ascent.
rows.anchor: { فلا تكن في مرية } من لقاء موسى عند بلوغك إلى مرتبته في معراجك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Ascension account places Moses in the fifth heaven, where the Prophet meets him while rising from the secret's intimate-conversation rank to the spirit's sacred-valley rank.
rows.anchor: كما ذكر في قصة المعراج أنه لقيه في السماء الخامسة وهو عند ترقيه عن مقام السر الذي هو مقام المناجاة إلى مقام الروح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The day of opening is the major resurrection with the Mahdi's appearance; faith then will not benefit the veiled because it is only verbal, and their punishment will not be lifted.
rows.anchor: المطلق يوم القيامة الكبرى بظهور المهدي لا ينفع إيمان المحجوبين حينئذ

words: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God and the angels' blessing of the Prophet is support, confirmations, and the outpouring of perfections; in every respect, with or without intermediaries, God is the true source of blessing.
rows.anchor: بالإمداد والتأييدات والإفاضة للكمالات فالمصلي في الحقيقة هو الله تعالى جميعا وتفصيلا بواسطة وغير واسطة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers bless him in a particular, detailed way by accepting his guidance and perfection and loving his essence and attributes, thereby supporting and completing the flow of grace.
rows.anchor: وحقيقة صلاتهم عليه قبولهم لهدايته وكماله ومحبتهم لذاته وصفاته فإنها إمداد له منهم وتكميل وتعميم للفيض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prayer God bless Muhammad expresses love and purity; salutation means treating him as free of defect while completing and affecting the believers' own selves, which is their prayer for peace upon him.
rows.anchor: وتسليمهم جعلهم إياه بريئا من النقص والآفة في تكميل نفوسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because the Prophet is so near to God that his selfhood is annihilated and no duality remains in pure love, whoever harms him harms God; God's enemy is utterly distant and so cursed in both worlds and humiliated by veiling.
rows.anchor: لأن النبي في غاية القرب منه بحيث يتحقق به بفناء أنيته ولم تبق أثنينية هناك لخلوص محبته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Hour may be near for those prepared for it.
rows.anchor: وما يدريك لعل الساعة تكون قريبا لمن استعد لها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Disbelievers are cursed because their veiling leaves them distant from God.
rows.anchor: { لعن الكافرين } لبعدهم عنه بالاحتجاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The city's inhabitants are the people of the body's city; its three messengers are spirit, heart, and intellect, first sending the spirit and heart to the body.
rows.anchor: يمكن أن يؤول أصحاب القرية بأهل مدينة البدن والرسل الثلاثة بالروح والقلب والعقل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The body rejects spirit and heart for lack of affinity and because they differ from it in light and darkness.
rows.anchor: لعدم التناسب بينهما وبينهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The third messenger is intellect, which accords with the self in interests and successes and influences it and its people by calling them to what heart and spirit call for.
rows.anchor: فعززوا بالعقل الذي يوافق النفس في المصالح والمناجح ويدعوها وقومها إلى ما يدعو إليه القلب والروح فيؤثر فيهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their bad omen is aversion to the messengers' call to discipline and spiritual struggle, which denies them pleasures and benefits.
rows.anchor: تنفرهم عنهم لحملهم إياهم على الرياضة والمجاهدة ومنعهم عن اللذات والحظوظ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Stoning the messengers means pelting them with natural impulses and bodily demands; tormenting them means dominating and using them to obtain animal and predatory appetites.
rows.anchor: رميهم بالدواعي الطبيعية والمطالب البدنية. وتعذيبهم إياهم: استيلاؤهم عليهم واستعمالهم في تحصيل الشهوات والبهيمية والسبعية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At subsistence after annihilation, God's light purifies the heart with gifted divine existence, so the expanded breast holds Real and creation without veiling and sees detail within unity and unity within multiplicity; Islam is annihilation and surrender to God.
rows.anchor: بنوره حال البقاء بعد الفناء ونقى قلبه بالوجود الموهوب الحقاني فيسع صدره الحق والخلق من غير احتجاب بأحدهما عن الآخر فيشاهد التفصيل في عين الوحدة والتوحيد في عين الكثرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one on a light from his Lord sees his Lord.
rows.anchor: فهو على نور من ربه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hard hearts refuse to receive God's remembrance because they cling to bodily pleasures and turn away from sacred perfections, straying clearly from the way of truth.
rows.anchor: للذين قست قلوبهم من قبول ذكر الله لشدة ميلها إلى اللذات البدنية وإعراضها عن الكمالات القدسية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Book is consistent in truth and is repeated because it descends to the heart before and after annihilation, alternating between the Real and creation.
rows.anchor: لتنزلها عليك في مقام القلب قبل الفناء وبعده فتكون مكررة باعتبار الحق والخلق

words: تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The skins of God-knowing scholars shiver as luminous forms descend upon the heart and their effects reach the body.
rows.anchor: أهل الخشية من العلماء بالله لانفعالها بالهيئات النوراينة الواردة على القلب النازل أثرها إلى البدن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their skins, hearts, and limbs then soften into compliance, calm, and tranquility as they turn to God's remembrance.
rows.anchor: وأعضاؤهم بالانقياد والسكينة والطمأنينة

words: ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The limbs become compliant and tranquil as they turn toward God's remembrance; this is God's guidance, through which He guides whom He wills.
rows.anchor: الانقياد والسكينة والطمأنينة { إلى ذكر الله

words: وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those God misguides are veiled from the light, cannot understand His speech or see its meaning, and have no guide.
rows.anchor: { ومن يضلل الله } يحجبه عن النور فلا يفهم كلامه ولا يرى معناه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The punished person has the face, the noblest organ, exposed because bodily dispositions bind the other limbs and prevent movement to protect himself, unlike one secure from punishment.
rows.anchor: مع كونه أشرف الأعضاء لكون سائر جوارحه مقيدة بهيئات لا يتأتي له التحرز بها ولا يتهيأ، مغللة بأغلال لا يتيسر له بها الحركة في الدفع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The veiled are driven to Hell by their deeds and guided there by the lower self's desire and downward inclination.
rows.anchor: { وسيق } المحجوبون { إلى جهنم } بسائق العمل وقائد الهوى النفسي والميل السفلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hell's gates open when they arrive because it eagerly longs for them and is suited to receive them.
rows.anchor: لشدة شوقها إليهم وقبولها لهم لما بينهما من المناسبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hell's keepers, Mālik and the zabāniya, symbolize bodily nature and the earthly angelic realm assigned to lower selves.
rows.anchor: { وقال لهم خزنتها } من مالك والزباينة، أي: الطبيعة الجسمانية والملكوت الأرضية الموكلة بالنفوس السفلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who avoid vices and the self's qualities are driven to Paradise by their deeds, led by love.
rows.anchor: { وسيق الذين اتقوا } الرذائل وصفات النفوس { إلى الجنة } بسائق العمل وقائد المحبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Paradise's doors are already open because mercy and God's effusion are always available; delay lies in the recipient's capacity, unlike Hell's gates, which open upon arrival because matter becomes receptive through its effects.
rows.anchor: قبل مجيئهم لأن أبواب الرحمة وفيض الحق مفتوحة دائما والتخلف من جهة القبول لا من جهة الفيض بخلاف أبواب جهنم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Paradise's keepers are Ridwan, the sacred spirits, and the heavenly angelic realm.
rows.anchor: من رضوان والأرواح القدسية والملكوت السماوية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their greeting is the divine attributes and exalted names pouring perfection upon them and freeing them from defect and affliction.
rows.anchor: تحيتهم الصفات الإلهية والأسماء العلية بإفاضة الكمال عليهم وتبرئتهم من الآفة والنقص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They have been purified of vile psychic qualities and material dispositions, so they enter the spiritual Garden of Firdaws destined to remain forever because their essences are free of bodily change.
rows.anchor: عن خبائث الأوصاف النفسانية والهيئات الهيولانية، فادخلوا جنة الفردوس الروحانية مقدرين الخلود لنزاهة ذواتكم عن التغيرات الجسمانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth's two days are two events, image and matter; day can mean an event because daily events resemble one another in appearing and disappearing.
rows.anchor: في حادثين كما ذكر أن اليوم معبر به عن الحادث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God increases the earth's good and assigns provision and livelihood in four days, the four qualities and elements from which compounds are made through mixing and adjustment for those who seek sustenance.
rows.anchor: هي الكيفيات الأربع والعناصر الأربعة التي خلق منها المركبات بالتركيب والتعديل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's turning to create heaven marks the difference in perfection between the creations, and their different direction and substance, not temporal delay since time did not yet exist.
rows.anchor: قصد إلى إيجادها وثم للتفاوت بين الخلقين في الإحكام وعدمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Heaven's smoke is a subtle substance, unlike dense, heavy earthly substances.
rows.anchor: جوهر لطيف بخلاف الجواهر الكثيفة الثقيلة الأرضية

words: فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ٱئْتِيَا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًۭا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's command and will attached to bringing heaven and earth into existence, and both came immediately and obediently; this is figurative, since no actual speech occurred.
rows.anchor: تعلق أمره وإرادته بإيجادهما فوجدتا في الحال معا كالمأمور المطيع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan's incitement is a sting that provokes answering an injury with harm, calls for revenge, and stirs anger.
rows.anchor: ينخسنك نخس بالمقابلة بالسيئة وداعية بالانتقام وهيجان من غضبك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seeking God's protection means returning and taking refuge in Him from Satan's evil and whispering by disowning one's actions and attributes and annihilating one's own power.
rows.anchor: بالرجوع إلى جنابه واللجوء إلى حضرته من شره ووسوسته ونزغه بالبراءة عن أفعالك وصفاتك والفناء فيه عن حولك وقوتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God hears the mind's private thoughts and one's words, and knows intentions and hidden conditions.
rows.anchor: { إنه هو السميع } لما هجس ببالك من أحاديث نفسك وأقوالك { العليم } بنياتك وما بطن من أحوالك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Night is the self's darkness veiling the light and making one prone to sins and satanic whispers; day is the spirit's light shining from the heart, enabling good deeds, resistance to evil, and receptivity to divine breezes.
rows.anchor: ليل ظلمة النفس بظهور صفاتها الساترة للنور لتقعوا في السيئات وتستعدوا لقبول الوساوس الشيطانية ونهار نور الروح بإشراق أشعتها من القلب إلى النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sun is the spirit; one must not annihilate in it and stop there, becoming veiled from the Real.
rows.anchor: بالفناء فيه والوقوف معه والاحتجاب به عن الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The moon is the heart; one must not stop with its virtues and perfections or incline to the Paradise of attributes.
rows.anchor: بالوقوف مع الفضائل والكمالات والنبو إلى جنة الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: True prostration is annihilation in the divine essence, reserving worship for God alone in un veiled unity.
rows.anchor: { واسجدوا لله الذي خلقهن } بالفناء في الذات { إن كنتم } موحدين، مخصصين العبودية به دون غيره لا مشركين ولا محجوبين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pride is refusal of annihilation, with egohood, rebellion, superiority, and aggression appearing through the self's attributes.
rows.anchor: عن الفناء فيه بظهور الأنائية والطغيان والاستعلاء بصفات النفس والعدوان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those near God are the forerunners annihilated in Him; they continually glorify Him by stripping away the veils of their selves and qualities in concealment and manifestation, never tiring because they stand in God and remember through essential love.
rows.anchor: { فالذين عند ربك } من السابقين الفانين فيه { يسبحون له } بالتجريد والتنزيه عن حجب ذواتهم وصفاتهم دائما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This taunt signals reversed conditions caused by a corrupted primordial nature: bodily pleasure, might, and psychic dignity become spiritual pain, humiliation, and abasement.
rows.anchor: إشارة إلى انعكاس أحوالها لانتكاس فطرتها

words: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their doubt arose from assuming that pleasure and pain are only sensory and from being veiled from intellectual pleasures and pains.
rows.anchor: لحسبانكم انحصار اللذات والآلام في الحسية واحتجابكم بها عن العقلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fully pious are perfected by avoiding the remaining traces of selfhood; their gardens are the three high gardens, and their springs are knowledge of spiritual states, gnosis, and other true benefits.
rows.anchor: { إن المتقين } الكاملين في التقوى باجتناب البقايا { في جنات } عالية من الجنان الثلاث { وعيون } من علوم الأحوال والمعارف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fine silk represents subtle states and gifts such as love, gnosis, annihilation, and subsistence that they embody; brocade represents virtues such as patience, contentment, forbearance, and generosity.
rows.anchor: { يلبسون من سندس } لطائف الأحوال والمواهب لاتصافهم بها كالمحبة والمعرفة والفناء والبقاء { وإستبرق } فضائل الأخلاق كالصبر والقناعة والحلم والسخاوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They face one another at equal ranks in the first rank of spirits, without veils because their essences are stripped and they appear before God beyond their attributes.
rows.anchor: على رتب متساوية في الصف الأول من صفوف الأرواح لا حجاب بينهم لتجرد ذواتهم وبروزهم إلى الله عن صفاتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their companions are whatever brings delight to their eyes and comfort to their hearts as they reach the Beloved and attain the full object of their desire.
rows.anchor: قرناهم بما فيه قرة أعينهم واستئناس قلوبهم لوصولهم بمحبوبهم وحصولهم على كمال مرادهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lineage brings no honor because all share human origin; peoples and tribes enable recognition, not boasting. Honor comes only by avoiding vices, which is the root of piety.
rows.anchor: لا كرامة بالنسب لتساوي الكل في البشرية المنتسبة إلى ذكر وأنثى والامتياز بالشعوب والقبائل إنما يكون لأجل التعارف بالانتساب لا للتفاخر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Piety ranks upward from avoiding legal sins to avoiding moral vices such as ignorance, miserliness, greed, avarice, and cowardice.
rows.anchor: المتقي عن المناهي الشرعية التي هي الذنوب في عرف ظاهر الشرع أكرم من الفاجر وعن الرذائل الخلقية كالجهل والبخل والشره والحرص والجبن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Beyond moral virtue is trust in God and witnessing God's acts rather than crediting effects to others; beyond this is seeing through acts to the manifestations of God's acts.
rows.anchor: ومشاهدة أفعال الحق أكرم من الفاضل المتدرب بالفضائل الخلقية المعتد بتأثير الغير، المحجوب برؤية أفعال الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Higher still is release from attribute-veils through satisfaction and erasure of attributes, then annihilation of the particular selfhood that is the root of sins.
rows.anchor: المحجوب بالصفات عن تجليات صفات الحق وعن وجوده المخصوص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows the different ranks of people's piety and is aware of their relative degrees.
rows.anchor: { إن الله عليم } بمراتب تقواكم { خبير } بتفاضلكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People acknowledge God's creation of first realities such as spirits and heavens but doubt creation renewed each moment; Satan confuses them into blaming time and veils them from God's continual creative action, so they deny resurrection.
rows.anchor: إما اهتدينا إلى إبداع الحقائق وإيجاد الأشياء الأولية كالأرواح والسموات وأمثالها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He cites the claim that time alone destroys people as an example of their assigning causal power to time.
rows.anchor: ونسبوا التأثير إلى الزمان واحتجبوا عن معنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are veiled from the verse that says God is engaged in a new affair each day; true knowledge would let them witness creation anew at every instant, accept resurrection, and become sincere servants beyond Satan's sway.
rows.anchor: كل يوم هو في شأن

words: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The vein is a sensory image for spiritual nearness, but bodily connection entails separation and two-ness; God's nearness and presence are not spatial contact or comparison.
rows.anchor: تمثيل للقرب المعنوي بالصورة الحسية المشاهدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The human's embedded reality is not other than God; particular existence exists only through the divine reality of existence, without which it would be sheer nothingness.
rows.anchor: فإن هويته وحقيقته المندرجة في هويته وتحققه ليست غيره بل إن وجوده المخصوص المعين إنما هو بعين حقيقته التي هي الوجود من حيث هو وجود ولولاه لكان عدما صرفا

rows.speaker: أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام
rows.claim: Ali says God is with every thing without conjunction: a thing is itself through Him, and apart from Him there is no thing with which to compare Him.
rows.anchor: كما قال أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام: " هو مع كل شيء "
